_what: mock3's OWN PRD. Authored, never ingested: this project exists to rehearse the pipeline without any client system in the loop, so there is no Jira to synthesise from. The stories describe OBSERVABLE defects that exist in the codelines right now, each proven by an executable probe before this file was written -- a rehearsal against a defect that is not really there teaches nothing.
title: mock3 rehearsal

project.name: mock3
project.description: A two-codeline transit-fares and departure-board workspace used to exercise the orchestration pipeline end to end.

stories.title: Riders aged exactly 65 are charged the adult fare
stories.description: The fare rules say riders aged 65 and over pay the concession fare. A rider aged exactly 65 is charged the full adult fare of 350 cents instead of 175. Riders aged 66 and above are charged correctly, so the boundary itself is wrong rather than the rule.
acceptanceCriteria: A rider aged exactly 65 with no pass is charged the concession fare.
A rider aged 64 with no pass is still charged the base fare.
The existing fare behaviour for children, pass holders and adults is unchanged.

fixSiteAnalysis.reason: This function computes the fare for a rider. The comparison `rider.age > 65` on line 10 excludes age 65 from the concession tier, causing riders aged exactly 65 to fall through to the base fare. Changing `>` to `>=` makes age 65 satisfy the condition, producing the concession fare as the rules require.
fixSiteAnalysis.fix: Change `rider.age > 65` to `rider.age >= 65` on line 10 of src/fares.ts. Reuse the existing constant CONCESSION_FARE_CENTS (already imported/declared in this file) ? no new helper needed.

fixSiteAnalysis.reason: This test file exercises fareFor but does not cover age 65 (the boundary). Existing tests use ages 8, 30, and 70. After the production fix, all existing tests still pass, but age 65 remains untested. This file needs no edit (test agent owns it), only verification that existing tests continue to pass.
fixSiteAnalysis.fix: No edit required. Verify that existing tests still pass after the production change. The test suite does not yet cover age 65 ? that coverage gap is for the test agent to address separately.

stories.title: The departure board omits the final stop
stories.description: formatStops renders every stop except the last one, so a three-stop line shows two. The journey length reported by totalMinutes is correct, which is why the omission has gone unnoticed.
acceptanceCriteria: Every stop on the line appears on the rendered board, including the final one.
Stops remain separated by the existing arrow separator.
An empty line still renders without error.
